model.name: RoomFolder.createAndManage
model.description: Server API: POST /api/room/<roomId>/folder (create). PUT /api/room/<roomId>/folder/<folderId> (rename). DELETE /api/room/<roomId>/folder/<folderId>. POST /api/room/<roomId>/folder/<folderId>/move (move file into folder). Folder scenario unit: ior:class:Folder, model.children=[] (file IORs), ownerIor=Room IOR. Room.files[] updated to include folder IOR. /api/trace/children for Folder type returns its children.
